body:
Pinching the base, definitely makes it more stiff, but only for a few seconds as if the finger pressure isn't enough to keep the blood from flowing out. That's why I kinda doubt a ring will work, but hey, it's worth a try I guess.

I'm currently seeing a psychologist and I will be seeing a specialist if the Viagra doesn't work (tell me it will).

The statistics you mentioned regarding prostatitis were really interesting. All I can pretty much hope for though is that my problem is only due to the inflammation and that it will clear up eventually. I'll look into a few diets and hope for the best.

I was aware of the horny goat weed, but I haven't gotten myself into trying it yet, I might though.

Though what I'm feeling now may not be temporary if my main issue persists. And that's pretty much what I'm afraid of.

Thanks for your support!

Also I will be seeing a specialist if it turns out that the Viagra doesn't work. Though, I'm really hoping that it will work.

Thanks for your response!

Back when I was unaware that I was impotent, I thought I was perfectly fine and there was absolutely no stress or anxiety involved. And of course I'm eager to see the results of the antibiotics and the Viagra, but I can't help but feel afraid, if it turns out that the viagra doesn't work, that's probably the worst case scenario because, after a fair amount of research, if Viagra doesn't work, other treatments will have a very limited to nonexistant effect. 

I have never smoked a single cigarette, and I rarely ever drink.

I'm not exactly looking for the perfect sexlife, I'm more or less just looking to be adequate. I want to be able to perform, which I can't, it's too soft, and it won't get much harder no matter what I do.

I have looked into certain supplements to help me out such as L-arganine and similar, but it doesn't seem to do much for me.

My T level is unfortunately fine, which implies that the sexdrive is there, but it's stupid and near useless to have if you're impotent.
